not_final: the final setting: this is the corrections comparison

notes.protocol: every figure is defined in eval/PROTOCOL-stage2.md, written before the run, with what eval/PROTOCOL-stage2-addition-corrections-2026-11-07.md, eval/PROTOCOL-stage2-addition-designators-pattern-2026-11-07.md, eval/PROTOCOL-stage2-addition-region-columns-2026-11-07.md, eval/PROTOCOL-stage2-addition-whole-batch-2026-11-07.md adds to it; each file's digest at the time of the run is under `protocol`
notes.proportions: count of n; rate, low and high are fractions of 1; low and high are the 95% Wilson score interval, z = 1.959964, no continuity correction
notes.citation: the heading id in the judge's validated answer about region 1, the most anomalous area; an image with no citation counts as wrong
notes.units: *_seconds and seconds are wall-clock seconds; *_mib is MiB as xpu-smi reports it; minutes are seconds / 60; anomaly scores and thresholds are raw PatchCore distances
notes.percentiles: numpy.percentile, linear interpolation between the ranked values
notes.cold: the cold comes from the server's start: vLLM ignores the request's cache_prompt and says nothing, so the server is started with its prefix cache off; judge.cold holds the flags as its container's command line gives them, the engine's own word, and the hit rate read from its log during the run, which above 0.0% voids the run
notes.corrections: corrections were recalled into the prompts from the declared store only, by the product's own recall; `declared_store` holds its digest, its recall and the boards it was drawn from, which are left out of the figures and keep their lines; `leak` counts the decisions with a correction in a prompt, and a correction from any other store voids the run
notes.not_held_out: the anomaly model's thresholds were chosen on the same test split, and the judge's prompt was written with sight of some of its images: see eval/PROTOCOL-stage2.md
notes.inspector: parse time is measured in this run and includes loading the parser's models; fit time is the one recorded when each part's model was trained, not repeated here
notes.memory: the anomaly model's card and the judge's are read from xpu-smi, each stage's under `memory` with the card it read; the judge's own process stays null in its container, where xpu-smi ps does not list it, and the card stands for it, 42 MiB on an idle card
notes.warm_up: one question before the judge's clock, as judged on the first flagged image and not recorded; judge.warm_up says it was asked and how long it took, not what it answered
notes.on_threshold: the rule is a strict >, so float noise decides a board whose score sits on its threshold: those of this run's boards are under `on_threshold` and the figure is read with them known
notes.quantisation: judge.server.quantisation is the engine's own word in its line in the server's log: `None` for weights it runs unquantised, `fp8` for FP8's, under the same dtype; a record without it was written before it was read, or the line and the flag could not be read
